about: Known disagreements between the game files (maplestory.io MCW) and the MapleStory Classic Wiki. Our data keeps the game's value; the weekly fact check lists these under 'unconfirmed' instead of failing. Add an entry once a new disagreement has been looked at; remove it when the sources agree again. ignore_new: source entries that look new but are not released content.

disagree.note: Primrose Hill (Moon Bunny PQ): the wiki's v2.0.0 page has Stirge 4, Flyeye 2, Goblin Fire 2; the pre-v2.0 MCW/1 files Goblin Fire 2, Flyeye 1. Ours follows the wiki until maplestory.io has v2.0 files
Someone Else's Grave: the pre-v2.0 MCW/1 files have an exit to Bygone Days the wiki's v2.0.0 page lacks. Recheck when maplestory.io has v2.0 files

Precipice of Darkness (Forgotten Hollow, v2.0): the wiki lists Zombie Mushroom 6; the game files place mob 800011 there, which our monster list names Zombie Mushroom (Bowman 2nd job test), so the check does not count them. Ours follows the wiki. Recheck if the wiki adds a variant row
Roger's Apple: the game lists item 2010000 with no count; the wiki says 1
Roger's Apple: game no item reward, wiki 3 Apples

ignore_new.note: wiki-only, pre-launch, no id, giver or level
